facts.text: Mississauga is home to more than 100,000 companies, including over 775 multinational companies and more than 75 Fortune 500 firms.
Over the past five years Mississauga's software sector has recorded 138 percent employment growth, outpacing every other city in the Greater Toronto Area.
Toronto Pearson International Airport, located mainly in Mississauga, handled 46.8 million passengers in 2024 and expects 65 million by the early 2030s.
Toronto Pearson sits at the heart of Canada's second-largest employment zone, where 400 companies and agencies employ more than 52,000 people.

overview: Mississauga had 717,961 residents in the 2021 Census, a 0.5 percent decline from 721,599 in 2016, with 244,575 occupied private dwellings on 292.74 square kilometres. The population is not growing, so a local business here wins customers by taking them from competitors rather than by catching new arrivals.

The median age is 40.8 and the median household income was $102,000 in 2020, above the Toronto figure. That describes an established, relatively well-off customer base with settled buying habits. Businesses that show clear value and earn trust through reviews and referrals have the best chance of shifting those habits.

byService.lead-generation: With a flat population of about 718,000 since 2016, lead generation in Mississauga should target households already buying a service from someone else and give them a reason to switch.
byService.seo: Mississauga searchers with a $102,000 median household income compare options carefully, so SEO content that answers detailed questions and ranks for specific neighbourhoods wins more clicks than generic city pages.
byService.website-development: A website for Mississauga customers, whose median age is 40.8, should load fast on mobile, present pricing plainly and make booking or quoting possible without a phone call.
byService.branding: Because Mississauga hosts many large corporate head offices and a stable population, a local brand that looks professional and consistent earns credibility with both business and household buyers.
